title: RSA run 1
summary: Six inner-loop cells on Sherlock, 7 October 2026: the combined reference-game data (5 sources, 40k training trials) twice, and two recovery conditions twice each, with a ground-truth model withheld from the seeds. 5 rounds × 6 Gemini 3.8 Flash agents per cell.
findings: Recovery works on prediction distance: in all four recovery cells the exported model is 0.004–0.009 RMSE from the withheld ground truth, against 0.048–0.049 for the best starting model, and a live model sits even closer (0.0001–0.004).
On real data the loop finds models that generalise to held-out conditions: the best are +67 to +94 lpd over rsa_l2 (2–2.6 clustered SE), almost all of it on pragmods.

Selection does not track generalisation on real data. real_rep1 exported a model no better than rsa_l2 on held-out conditions (−7.5, SE 71) after its in-sample PSIS-LOO pruned the six models that generalise best; in recovery cells the two measures agree (r ≈ 1).
Literal/pragmatic mixtures and softmax-belief listeners are among the best held-out models in both real replicates.
decisions: Select and prune on grouped cross-validation over training conditions (the unit the test set holds out), not trial-level PSIS-LOO.
Recovery verdict: drop the held-out “or” clause (it passes the seeds on the salience data) and report the seeds’ and the closest live model’s distances.
Agents’ internet access: one cell read the lab’s pragmods RSA code from GitHub. Allowlist (model API and library docs only), no network, or report only?
Cluster defaults: the mcfrank partition, venvs in $GROUP_HOME, no --qos=long.
